channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump says he's banning MS NOW, CNN and Politico from White House
item.description: Trump, who often accuses mainstream media outlets of writing "fake news," said on Truth Social that those outlets shouldn't be allowed to "FICTION and LIES."

item.title: Trump says U.S. to build a 'large Military presence' in Greenland as part of a security deal with it and Denmark
item.description: Greenland has maintained it is not for sale, and the European Union earlier this year united to rebuke Trump over his push to acquire the island.

item.title: OpenAI's latest AI revelation is a 'serious situation,' Microsoft's Suleyman tells CNBC
item.description: Suleyman joined "Squawk Box" to discuss OpenAI's latest incidents of "concerning model behavior" disclosed earlier this week.

item.title: Three words from Kevin Warsh have Wall Street wondering how far the Fed will go with rate hikes
item.description: The chairman both explained this week's decision to raise interest rates, and raised vexing questions about what comes next

item.title: Anthropic selects Accenture as first embedded evaluator to help implement Amodei's slowdown proposal
item.description: Anthropic and OpenAI have been under intense scrutiny after researchers warned about the potential for AI to cause catastrophic harm to humanity.

item.title: Stocks face a key hurdle in next week’s U.S.-China summit. Here’s what’s at stake
item.description: The S&P 500 and the Dow Industrials posted weekly losses as investors grappled with rising yields. Next week's U.S.-China summit could be a wildcard for stocks.

item.title: AI cloud provider Nscale files to go public
item.description: Nscale is the latest artificial intelligence neocloud to turn to public markets.

item.title: Elon Musk talks up AI safety while fighting regulation in wild week of strange alliances
item.description: In the past week, Musk has agreed with the CEOs of Anthropic and OpenAI, while getting contradicted by President Trump and Nvidia's Jensen Huang.

item.title: JPMorgan, Citigroup CEOs attending Trump's state dinner for China's Xi: Sources
item.description: Dimon and Fraser join OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Nvidia chief Jensen Huang and others who are reportedly planning to attend the Trump-Xi state dinner.

item.title: SpaceX scores another $950 million from NASA for 3 more crewed flights to ISS
item.description: SpaceX is getting an extension to an existing contract that will allow three additional crewed Dragon flights to the International Space Station.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI need truly independent safety evaluators, experts say in public letter
item.description: A coalition of over 100 AI experts are urging independence and transparency from Anthropic, OpenAI and other foundation model labs to conduct evaluations.

item.title: AI safety debate meets reality at Dreamforce as business leaders say last year's models are enough
item.description: At Salesforce's annual mega-conference in San Francisco, attendees said they get enough value from older AI models.

item.title: Cramer’s week ahead: What to watch as Wall Street navigates a tough September
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors could be in for a relatively quiet week as Wall Street works its way through a historically difficult September.

item.title: Tokenization is set to change stock trading. These stocks could get a boost
item.description: Digital exchanges are rocketing upward in Friday morning trading after regulatory changes that follow the failure of the Clarity Act in Congress.

item.title: Nike parts ways with Kylian Mbappé; soccer superstar signs with On
item.description: Mbappe had been signed with Nike for roughly two decades, and his agreement with On is the first it has made with a soccer player.

item.title: Auto industry urges Trump to bar Chinese automakers in U.S. ahead of Xi visit
item.description: Leaders of six major auto trade groups joined to sign a letter to the president.

item.title: The Fed rate hike opens up an opportunity for muni bond investors
item.description: Here's where the experts now see opportunities in the municipal market.

item.title: McDonald's is the new 'Value Meal,' says trader Mike Khouw
item.description: McDonald's announced this week that it is revising its U.S. value strategy after recording its slowest sales growth in more than a year.

item.title: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway: 'Father Time always wins'
item.description: Buffett's son Howard will replace him as chairman, as dictated by a long-standing succession plan, Berkshire said.

item.title: JPMorgan oil team gives up on forecasting Iran war endgame as Trump blows past economic redlines
item.description: JPMorgan assumed at the start of the war that several economic redlines would force President Donald Trump into an agreement to open the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: What it will take for us to buy the dip in DuPont. Plus, profit-taking hits cyber stocks
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Amex launches high-yield savings account to complement business checking
item.description: Amex Business Savings offers an above-average return, plus no minimum balance requirement or monthly fees.

item.title: Social Security reform plans could sway voters in battleground Senate races, survey finds
item.description: Senators elected this November will be in office when Social Security's retirement trust fund is projected to run dry.

item.title: Fed staff should have known Silicon Valley Bank was vulnerable, new report finds
item.description: Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said a new report indicates the central bank's staff missed signs ahead of Silicon Valley Bank's 2023 failure.

item.title: Disney names CTO for the first time as media giant expands tech push
item.description: Disney has hired a chief technology officer, a newly minted role for the company, as it looks to further its embrace of tech under CEO Josh D'Amaro.

item.title: California Gov. Newsom issues executive order to rein in AI 'before it's too late'
item.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom and other 2028 Democratic presidential hopefuls have called for a more aggressive approach to addressing AI fears.

item.title: Wendy's franchisee files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection as burger chain struggles
item.description: One of Wendy's biggest U.S. franchisees, Meritage Hospitality Group, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.

item.title: Putin targets Nestle's Russian business as Kremlin tightens grip on Western assets
item.description: Nestlé is assessing its options after Russia placed the Swiss food giant’s local assets under temporary external administration.

item.title: Rep. Chip Roy doesn't want to regulate AI, but says Congress should have an oversight role
item.description: In an appearance on CNBC's "Squawk Box," Rep. Chip Roy, R-Texas, said he supports congressional hearings on AI, but wasn't keen on additional regulations.

item.title: Sportsbooks remain king this football season, but upstarts are making a run for the money
item.description: "Prediction markets are growing the overall market — at least for now," said Chris Grove, partner emeritus at Eilers & Krejcik Gaming.
